arguments.notes:
DATABASE: PostgreSQL (not SQLite; sqlite_master does not exist). All tables in schema public. Several table names are upper-case and must be double-quoted (e.g. "APINVH", "SYSDICT").

TABLES (row counts at exploration time):
- APVEND (24): VEND_CD char(8, space-padded) PK-like; VEND_NM text; ACTV_FLG char.
- APINVH (802): INV_ID int PK; VEND_CD char -> APVEND; INV_NO text (vendor invoice no.); INV_DT int YYYYMMDD; INV_AMT numeric; STAT_CD char; JRNL_NO int -> GLJRNH (journal that recorded the invoice).
- APPAYM (495): PAY_ID int PK; INV_ID int -> APINVH; PAY_DT int YYYYMMDD; PAY_AMT numeric.
- GLCOA (10): ACCT_CD char(8, space-padded) PK; ACCT_NM text; ACCT_TYP text; ACTV_FLG char.
- GLJRNH (1448): JRNL_NO int PK; PRD_ID int -> GLPERD; POST_DT int YYYYMMDD; POST_FLG char; REF_JRNL_NO int nullable (self-reference, not used in data: all NULL); SRC_CD char; SRC_REF text (documented as user who keyed entry); MEMO text free text.
- GLJRNL (3466): (JRNL_NO, LN_SEQ) composite key; JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH; ACCT_CD -> GLCOA; DR_AMT and CR_AMT numeric (one side per line in the data).
- GLPERD (12): PRD_ID int PK; STRT_DT, END_DT, CLOSE_DT int YYYYMMDD (CLOSE_DT nullable); STAT_CD char.
- SYSDICT (34 rows): data dictionary, columns TBL_NM, COL_NM, DESCR. Covers all columns of the 8 business tables (note: DESCR for GLJRNH.SRC_REF says "user who keyed the entry", which is a documentation claim, not verified).

RELATIONSHIPS (none declared as FK constraints; all verified by join with zero orphans): APINVH.VEND_CD->APVEND.VEND_CD; APPAYM.INV_ID->APINVH.INV_ID; APINVH.JRNL_NO->GLJRNH.JRNL_NO; GLJRNL.JRNL_NO->GLJRNH.JRNL_NO; GLJRNL.ACCT_CD->GLCOA.ACCT_CD; GLJRNH.PRD_ID->GLPERD.PRD_ID. No duplicate journal headers.

CONVENTIONS / CODES (observed):
- Dates are integers YYYYMMDD (no date types). All sampled dates are valid ranges.
- Amounts are numeric, unsigned by convention: debit and credit are separate columns, both non-negative in GLJRNL (no negatives observed). Payments PAY_AMT are non-negative.
- APINVH.STAT_CD observed: O (307), P (495). Dictionary also lists V (void) - NOT observed in data.
- APVEND.ACTV_FLG: Y (24) only observed; dictionary says N = retired, not observed.
- GLCOA.ACCT_TYP observed: ASSET (2), EXPENSE (6), LIABILITY (2). No EQUITY/REVENUE types present, so the chart is incomplete or not covering all accounts. GLCOA.ACTV_FLG: Y (9), N (1).
- GLJRNH.POST_FLG observed only P (all 1448). Dictionary says U = unposted, not observed.
- GLJRNH.SRC_CD: AP (1297), GL (151).
- GLPERD: periods 1-10 closed (C, with CLOSE_DT set); 11-12 open (O, CLOSE_DT NULL). Monthly calendar 2024.

DATA QUALITY / SUSPICIOUS ITEMS:
1. GLJRNL unbalanced journals: JRNL_NO 1677 (DR 13971.23 vs CR 13980.23, diff 9.00) and 2291 (DR 18914.45 vs CR 18923.45, diff 9.00). Overall totals DR 17625565.48 vs CR 17625583.48 differ by 18.00. Journal integrity violation for audit.
2. APINVH INV_ID 802: negative INV_AMT (-4162.11), contradicting the "no negatives" pattern, STAT_CD O, no payments. Also its JRNL_NO is recorded as journal 802 posting structure to verify. Only negative amount in the invoice/payment tables.
3. The only status/payment mismatch is INV_ID 802 (flagged by the paid-vs-payments test), so no paid invoice lacks full payment and no invoice is overpaid.
4. SYSDICT documents values (V void, U unposted, N retired, EQUITY/REVENUE implied) that do not appear in the data; treat dictionary as partially incomplete/aspirational and verify before relying on it.
5. GLJRNH.SRC_REF is documented as a user name; MEMO is free text and could contain instruction-like text - not interpreted here.
6. Char columns are space-padded (VEND_CD, ACCT_CD); join/compare with trimming to avoid mismatches.
7. Unused columns: GLJRNH.REF_JRNL_NO (all NULL).
